probe_dates.session_invariants: All probe dates verified as full regular XNYS trading sessions (is_early_close=false, opens=09:30 ET, closes=16:00 ET)

massive_query_semantics.pagination_policy: Terminal next_url cursor pagination required; failure if safety_max_pages reached or cycle detected

exchange_mapping_policy.security_type_audit_requirement: Preserve provider type values in metadata for audit

alpaca_query_semantics.asof_parameter_policy: Use asof=2024-01-02 for point-in-time ticker mapping

stage_a_prior_opening_ranges.window_per_session: 09:30:00 to 09:34:59 America/New_York (converted to UTC aware datetimes)

alpaca_query_semantics.rate_limit_policy: Honor retry-after on 429/5xx; fail closed on partial batches or unresolvable network errors

data_quarantine_rules: All raw provider payloads, daily bars, minute bars, and symbol lists must remain strictly in the private output root.
Never write raw market data inside the repository.
Never commit OHLCV rows, ticker symbol lists, or Top-20 ticker names.
Committed artifacts must contain only safe cryptographic summaries, counts, distributions, hashes, and resource estimates.

alpaca: GET /v2/stocks/bars for SPY (tiny SIP capability smoke test)
GET /v2/stocks/bars 1Day raw SIP for 2024-01-02 target universe over 2023-12-01..2023-12-29
GET /v2/stocks/bars 1Min raw SIP for 2024-01-02 target universe over 09:30-09:34 for prior 14 sessions + 2024-01-02
GET /v2/stocks/bars 1Min raw SIP for frozen Top 20 over 09:35-15:59 on 2024-01-02

forbidden_provider_calls: Brokerage, account, orders, or trade execution endpoints

resource_limits.action_on_exceed: STOP before broad Stage-A acquisition and report BLOCKED_RESOURCE_BOUND

candidate_pool_completeness_gate.interpretation: 100% of target universe active members must have complete computable Stage-A inputs.
candidate_pool_completeness_gate.insufficient_history_handling: Active securities lacking 14 prior sessions due to IPO listing age or symbol changes must be surfaced and classified separately; session does not pass; disposition BLOCKED_CANDIDATE_POOL_HISTORY_SEMANTICS.

strict_no_lookahead_boundary.requirement: Stage-A Top-20 selection must be computed, serialized, and cryptographically hashed before requesting any post-09:35 market data.
strict_no_lookahead_boundary.top_20_selection_artifact: Materialized privately; committed only as count (20) and SHA-256 hash.
